FX.title: [USD/JPY] DOWN: Oversold Momentum Persists as Safe-Haven Yen Strengthens Amid Geopolitical Escalation
tldr_points: USD/JPY trades at 155.59, well below MA20 at 159.01, confirming bearish trend structure.
RSI-14 at 28.87 signals deeply oversold conditions, suggesting potential tactical bounce before continuation lower.
Rising oil prices from US-Iran conflict and surging global yields create conflicting cross-currents, but JPY safe-haven flows dominate.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY at 155.59 below MA20; RSI-14 at 28.87 oversold as yen surges on US-Iran war and bond selloff, signaling extended downside.
FX.comment: Bearish trend structure below MA20 with oversold RSI-14; JPY safe-haven flows and narrowing yield spread favor continued downside.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] UP: Technical Oversold Near MA20 with Bullish Fundamentals
tldr_points: Price trading below MA20 with RSI indicating oversold conditions.
Futures and oil strength suggest near-term risk-on sentiment despite geopolitical risks.
Dividend king highlight provides fundamental support for equity upside.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 shows oversold near MA20; futures and oil strength support a bounce toward resistance in the short term outlooks
STOCKS.comment: Oversold near MA20 with bullish fundamentals and supportive futures/oil

CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] UP: Price above MA20, RSI bullish, macro supportive
tldr_points: Price trading above MA20 support at ~74.6k, indicating bullish trend.
RSI 65 shows moderate upward momentum without overbought extremes.
Gold correlation at six-year high and Coinbase board addition reinforce risk-on sentiment.
CRYPTO.excerpt: BTC holds above MA20 with RSI 65, bolstered by rising gold correlation and board addition at Coinbase, signaling upside..
CRYPTO.comment: Price above MA20 with supportive macro and moderate RSI indicates near‑term upside.
